slides.texte_overlay:
habits that help you
think more clearly

morning pages

write three pages by hand as soon as you wake up, about anything at all. emptying your head onto paper first thing makes room for clear thoughts all day.

one thing at a time

close every tab and every window except the one you're working in. your brain thinks far more clearly when it isn't quietly tracking ten other things in the background.

walking before deciding

before any important decision, go for a fifteen minute walk alone. moving your body loosens tangled thoughts in a way that sitting at a desk never quite does.

a daily lesson

spend 5 minutes a day learning one clear idea: a scientific concept, a moment in history, a principle of art. clear ideas going in make clear thinking come out.
slides.texte_sophia:
a daily lesson

i used to feel foggy all day. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: a scientific idea, a moment in history. clear ideas going in make clear thinking come out.

slides.texte_overlay:
sleeping on it

let any big decision wait at least one night. sleep quietly sorts through information while you rest, and the right answer is often obvious the next morning.
